g.text: Stage 1 detector and Stage 2 policy retrieval retain complete CustomerSnapshot semantics.
AnalysisContextBuilder is the application-owned cut immediately before the model port:
full-history aggregates stay exact while model-facing details are deterministically bounded.
OperatorContextPort is project-owned; Spring Security types stop at its adapter.
The remaining participants are application ports/contracts. RAG is the
PolicyKnowledgePort stage, not the complete analysis architecture.
